newsitem.title: GREECE: PROFIT TAKING PULLS GREEK SHARES BACK AFTER RALLY.
newsitem.headline: PROFIT TAKING PULLS GREEK SHARES BACK AFTER RALLY.

text.p: Greek equities gave up some of Monday's gains as profit taking after a five-day rally saw prices correct in heavy trading volume of 12.4 billion drachmas. Brokers said the outlook remained bullish and expected the correction would fizzle out around 960 points.

"There was profit taking today led by bank shares and this pulled the market lower. Construction shares also looked fatigued. The correction does not violate the market's uptrend, we could go a little lower, around 960 points on the index," said broker Evangelos Haratsis at Beta Securities.

"The high volumes in recent days indicate that there have been inflows and positioning in shares. The market is looking forward to a strong government after the elections, regardless of which of the two major parties wins. Today's reaction was not politics related nervousness but simple profit taking," he said.
Greece will hold early elections September 22.

The Athens general share index closed 0.78 percent, or 7.56 points lower at 966.64 from Monday's 974.20 close after opening at 974.77 points. Turnover rose to 12.4 billion drachmas from 11.9 billion on Monday on volume of 5.96 million shares.
Losers led gainers 170 to 53 with 22 issues unchanged on 245 traded. Banks slipped 0.78 percent, industrials lost 1.08 percent and construction fell 1.23 percent. Small-caps retreated 0.42 percent.
On Friday, market watchers sensed the beginning of a bull trend saying further gains could unfold with the market discounting a strong government after the elections.

The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 562-580 at the close. Shares of OTE telecom, the underlying, ended unchanged at 4,070 drachmas after active trade.

The recently launched Merrill Lynch stock index call warrant based on a basket of 23 shares was quoted lower at 216.90-228.30 drachmas. It expires on January 9 1998 with a strike price of 1000. It was in the money at 1057.1.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted lower at 4,453-4,753 drachmas at the close. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
